definitions.normal: mean PSA yield of the same unit, crop and quarter over years 2002..Y-1 (null with fewer than 3 years)
definitions.ndvi_anom: MODIS NDVI peak minus its mean over earlier years (same unit, crop, quarter)
definitions.evi_anom: MODIS EVI peak minus its mean over earlier years
definitions.rain_anom: growing-window rainfall minus the 1981-2000 ERA5 climatology, mm
definitions.rain_pct: rain_anom as % of the climatology for the same window

flags.b0_fallback: no same-quarter value last year; B0 used the unit-quarter mean
flags.no_area_forecast: newly regrouped unit without area history; no production forecast
flags.area_unit_mean: no area last year; unit's mean area used
flags.outlier: PSA value flagged as an outlier in Phase 1

definitions.area_note: assumes the same harvested area as the same quarter last year
definitions.conditions_note: context, not used in the forecast
